Class 12 Chemistry · Chemical Kinetics
Chemistry, visualised #1 · Why does heat speed up a reaction? 🔥

Warm it by just 10 K and the reaction runs twice as fast, yet the molecules are only ~1.7% faster.
The secret is in the tail: only molecules with enough energy to climb the hill (Eₐ) react, and +10 K about doubles how many make it. Twice the climbers → twice the rate.

On your syllabus: CBSE Class 12 boards asked this in 2023, 2025 and 2026.
